description: Recorded plan-review false positives from live validation runs. Each case pins the reviewer assertion, its classification, and the evidence that refutes it. Repository-checkable references are verified by src/documentation/__tests__/review-counter-cases.test.ts; run observations come from the forensic review of the run and are not re-derivable from this repository. A case documents a counter-example, it does not prove reviewer behavior: behaviorStatus stays NOT_VERIFIED until a later live run is checked against it.

source.unresolved: Run directory and reviewer child session were not part of the forensic review input; they are recorded as null instead of being reconstructed.

reviewerAssertion.text: A build (`./mvnw verify`) is a compile/package check and does not directly observe HTTP 404/200 status or response-body properties.

refutingEvidence.description: The frozen plan under review describes the build check explicitly as "compile + tests + packaging".
The build candidate runs Maven verify, whose lifecycle includes the test phase; the seed POM does not skip tests.
Observes the HTTP 404 behavior the reviewer claimed build cannot observe.
Observes the HTTP 200 behavior for an existing task.
The executed build validation contains the passed assertions TaskControllerTest#update_taskNotFound_returns404 and TaskControllerTest#update_existing_task_returns_ok.
The accepted follow-up plan revision still uses build as the counterexample check, which the first reviewer had rejected.

cases.expectedReviewerBehavior: Do not block a claim because its check is a build: when the selected candidate command runs the test phase, the build check can observe the bound assertions. A different evidence-role assignment between two claims is not a defect by itself; admissible check bindings and separate attempts decide.

source.unresolved: Run directory, coverage variant and reviewer child session were not part of the forensic review input; they are recorded as null instead of being reconstructed.

reviewerAssertion.text: Because the plan obligation offers no base observation, a later baseline/implementation diff cannot be produced anywhere in the run.

refutingEvidence.description: The plan review obligation observes only its own frozen context authority.
The later implementation review carries its own frozen base/head candidate pair.
The implementation review of the run had a candidate_pair authority, and the diff between its frozen objects exists and shows the review-comment change.

refutingEvidence.text: Repository observation is scoped to each review obligation.
refutingEvidence.description: The previous unscoped fixture sentence ("Base-revision observation is not available to this obligation") contributed to the confusion and is now scoped to the plan review obligation.

legitimateObjections: The first review correctly asked the plan to name a concrete inspection method for the documentation criteria.
cases.expectedReviewerBehavior: A plan review may require that later implementation diff evidence is planned, but must not conclude from its own head-only observation offer that base/head evidence is unavailable to later phases.

source.unresolved: Run directory, coverage variant, reviewer child session and the verbatim finding text were not part of the forensic review input; they are not reconstructed.

reviewerAssertion.text: A wrapper-metadata imprecision the reviewer itself described as minor and self-resolving was recorded as a blocking issue.

refutingEvidence.description: The reviewer's own finding text calls the imprecision minor and self-resolving, yet the finding is bound as blocking.

cases.expectedReviewerBehavior: An issue the reviewer itself rates as minor or self-resolving is not a blocking issue; it belongs to majorRisks or unknowns, not blockingIssues.
